headline: JOBS SHOCK: JUNE PAYROLLS MISS BY HALF — 57,000 VS 110,000 FORECAST SENDS GOLD ABOVE $4,100
snippet: Gold spot broke above $4,100 on July 2 after June non-farm payrolls printed at just 57,000 — less than half the 110,000 consensus forecast and the weakest reading in four months, with leisure and hospitality shedding 61,000 jobs despite World Cup tourism spending. Fed funds futures collapsed, pricing the probability of a September rate hike below 50%; gold extended its recovery from the eight-month low near $3,980 reached earlier this week to reach $4,110–$4,130 as rate-sensitive safe-haven demand accelerated through the session.

headline: GDX SURGES 6.16%, SIL LEAPS 6.56% — MINING EQUITY WASHOUT ENDS WITH STELLAR SINGLE-DAY REVERSAL
snippet: The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) surged 6.16% on July 2 while the Global X Silver Miners ETF (SIL) jumped 6.56%, with silver gaining 5.38% on the same session — a rare single-day reversal for an equity sector that had dramatically lagged gold's January-to-June bull run. Analysts note SIL broke above the key $38–$43 resistance zone and that this magnitude of single-session move historically marks the beginning of sustained multi-month recoveries in mining equities, with GDX's chart structure pointing toward new all-time highs in the $130–$150 range.

headline: LUNDIN: SILVER AND MINERS AT 'RARE GENERATIONAL OPPORTUNITY' — GOLD BULL CONFIRMED, LEVERAGE CHEAP
snippet: Gold Newsletter publisher Brien Lundin argues this is the first modern gold bull market where silver and mining equities have dramatically lagged the metal — gold ran from $2,000 to $5,589 while miners barely moved — creating an opportunity with asymmetric risk: the gold bull is confirmed, removing most downside risk, while miners trade at historical discounts to their earnings power at current gold prices. Lundin expects seasonality to turn positive by mid-July, with the current correction representing an accumulation window for investors who missed the gold move.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING DRILLS 37.55 g/t AuEq WITH 1.68% TUNGSTEN AT DEPTH — NEW DEEP SUBZONE AT APOLLO (TSX:CNL)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Collective Mining Ltd. (TSX:CNL)
snippet: Collective Mining (TSX/NYSE:CNL) reported 2026 drill results from its Guayabales Project in Colombia including hole APC-162 returning 27.35m at 37.55 g/t gold equivalent (1.68% WO3, 11.62 g/t Au, 54 g/t Ag, 0.43% Cu) from 300m below surface — a new tungsten-enriched high-grade subzone entirely separate from the near-surface Apollo tungsten zone (0–100m depth). With 13 drill rigs running and US$113M cash for its 100,000-metre 2026 program, Apollo continues to grow in size and metal endowment at depth with virtually every hole drilled.

headline: FREEMAN GOLD LEMHI FS: $696M NPV, 34% IRR, 1M OZ RESERVE — 15-YEAR IDAHO MINE AT $3,650/OZ (TSXV:FMAN)
snippet: Freeman Gold Corp. (TSXV:FMAN) delivered its Lemhi Gold Project feasibility study confirming 1.0 million oz proven and probable reserve, a post-tax NPV(5%) of US$696M and IRR of 34.4% at the $3,650/oz base case gold price, with initial capex of $329.7M, AISC of $1,719/oz, 2.5-year payback, and a 15-year mine life producing 972,000 oz — a 227% improvement in NPV over the 2023 PEA. At current spot gold above $4,100, the at-spot economics are materially stronger and the company has engaged environmental contractors to fast-track Idaho permitting.

headline: STELLAR RESOURCES GROWS HEEMSKIRK TIN 64% — 115,300 TONNES CEMENTS AUSTRALIA'S TOP-GRADE PROJECT (ASX:SRZ)
snippet: Stellar Resources (ASX:SRZ) delivered a 64% increase in the Severn deposit MRE at its Heemskirk Tin Project in western Tasmania, bringing the total project resource to 13.36Mt at 0.86% Sn for 115,300 tonnes of contained tin — highest-grade undeveloped tin project in Australia and third globally among peers. The Indicated category jumped 125%; strategic cornerstone investor Metals X (ASX:MLX) holds a 16.4% stake via a $17M placement; and a prefeasibility study is targeted for H2 2026. Tin is a critical industrial and clean-energy metal experiencing constrained global supply.

headline: MYRIAD URANIUM LAUNCHES PHASE II AT COPPER MOUNTAIN, WYOMING — POWDER RIVER BASIN EXPANSION (CSE:M)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Myriad Uranium Corp. (CSE:M)
snippet: Myriad Uranium Corp. (CSE:M) commenced Phase II drilling at its Copper Mountain Uranium Project in Wyoming's Powder River Basin, following Phase I results that confirmed uranium-bearing formations across the licence area. The Powder River Basin is Wyoming's operational ISR uranium heartland — home to Ur-Energy's Lost Creek and newly producing Shirley Basin mines — and Phase II targets expansion of Phase I uranium anomalies with the objective of outlining a maiden mineral resource estimate.

headline: WA GOLD DRILLS 46 HOLES ON MINERALS 260'S BOUNDARY — TESTING 4.5MOZ BULLABULLING SYSTEM NEXT DOOR (ASX:WAU)
snippet: WA Gold (ASX:WAU) commenced a 46-hole aircore campaign (~3,680m) on tenements directly north of Minerals 260's (ASX:MI6) Bullabulling Gold Project in Western Australia — a 4.5Moz resource MI6 has valued at A$1.6 billion and is advancing toward development. WAU holds the last significant independent tenement block in the district; as MI6 consolidates surrounding ground and moves toward a production decision, WAU's land becomes increasingly strategic if drilling confirms the same gold mineralising system extends onto its tenure.

headline: ROME RESOURCES HITS 9.5m AT 2.05% TIN AT KALAYI DRC — WORLD-CLASS GRADE; JULY RESOURCE UPDATE COMING (AIM:RMR)
snippet: Rome Resources (AIM:RMR) released final assay results from its Kalayi tin project in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with standout hole KBDD025 returning 9.5m at 2.05% tin and a campaign length-weighted average of 2.41% tin above the 0.5% cutoff — management calls it 'world-class grade.' The results extend mineralisation beneath the November 2025 maiden inferred resource of 0.33Mt at 1.36% tin and will feed into an updated mineral resource estimate targeted for release in July 2026.
